title: Northloop Protect Plans Cancellation Terms: Full and Prorated Refunds
content:
**Clause.** Cancelling a plan under the Northloop Protect Plans is the buyer's own decision and is confirmed by the buyer. A plan cancelled within the free cancel days counted in calendar days from the plan's purchase date, with no settlement paid, is refunded in full. Any later cancellation is refunded the plan price times the unused coverage days over the term days, less the administrative fee (the admin rate times the plan price, capped at the admin fee cap) and less settlements already paid; a negative result is a refund of 0.00. A plan cancelled before coverage starts is always refunded in full.

On every plan the free cancellation period is 30 calendar days, the administrative fee rate is 10 per cent of the plan price and the administrative fee cap is 25.00 USD.

## The prorated refund defined

The prorated refund is the plan price multiplied by the unused coverage days and divided by the term days, less the administrative fee, less the claim settlements already paid on the plan (its claims paid total). The administrative fee is the lower of 10 per cent of the plan price and 25.00 USD. The amount so obtained is rounded to the cent once, as a whole; where it is below zero, the refund is 0.00. Term days are the plan's total coverage days; unused days are the coverage days not yet used at cancellation.

## Which refund applies

| Facts at cancellation | Refund |
|---|---|
| Coverage has not yet started | Full |
| Within 30 calendar days of the purchase date, no settlement paid | Full |
| After the 30 calendar days | Prorated, as defined above, never below 0.00 |

## What the cancellation shows on the plan

The plan moves to cancelled with its cancel date, from either the purchased or the active status. The refund record states its basis (full or prorated), the administrative fee withheld, the unused days, the term days and the amount, which is 0.00 when nothing is due. The plan premium is counted net of cancellation refunds.

## Refunds worked on hypothetical inputs

**Example 1.** Plan price 134.99 USD; term days 730; unused days 500; no settlements paid; cancelled after the free period. The plan price multiplied by 500 and divided by 730 is 92.45890 USD. The administrative fee is the lower of 13.499 USD and 25.00 USD, that is 13.499 USD. 92.45890 less 13.499 is 78.95990, rounded to 78.96 USD.

**Example 2.** Plan price 329.99 USD; term days 1461; unused days 400; settlements already paid 120.00 USD. The prorated share is 90.34634 USD; the administrative fee is the lower of 32.999 USD and 25.00 USD, that is 25.00 USD. 90.34634 less 25.00 less 120.00 is below zero, so the refund is 0.00.

**Example 3.** A plan is bought on 2026-05-02 and cancelled on 2026-05-09, before the covered item is delivered: coverage has not started, so the refund is in full.

**Example 4.** A plan is bought on 2026-05-02, coverage started on 2026-05-06, no settlement has been paid, and it is cancelled on 2026-05-20, 18 calendar days after purchase: within the free period, so the refund is in full.
